snippet.title: Do Kalime: Zabaan Par Halke, Tarazu Mein Bhaari | Sahih Bukhari 7563 #shorts
snippet.description:
Kya aap jaante hain? Do aise kalime, jo zabaan par halke hain, magar tarazu mein bohat bhaari.

Hamare Nabi Muhammad-e-Mustafa (Sallallahu Ta'ala Alaihi Wa Aalihi Wasallam) ne farmaya (Abu Huraira Radi Allahu Anhu se riwayat): do kalime hain jo zabaan par halke, tarazu (meezan) mein bhaari, aur Rahmaan ko bohat pyaare hain:
«سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ»
SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi, SubhanAllahil Azeem.

Reference
• Sahih al-Bukhari 7563 (Sahih Bukhari ki aakhri hadith): https://sunnah.com/bukhari:7563
• Sahih al-Bukhari 6406: https://sunnah.com/bukhari:6406

Chalte phirte, kaam karte, raaste mein, kitchen mein, das second bhi nahin lagte. Aaj sau baar parhne ki niyyat karein, aur comment mein likhein: SubhanAllah. Yeh video aage bhejein, yeh bhi ek aur sadqah hai. One more sadqah 🤍
